stamp: STRESS TEST - exaggerated values, not real, not for any use

event.name: Hurricane Florence (2018) - hindcast replay
event.note: Replay of the NWM v3.0 retrospective (free-running hindcast). The 18 'forecast hours' are replay hours, not a forecast issued at the time.

scenario.closure_rule_note: A crossing's whole road segment is removed while its reach flow exceeds its 10-year recurrence flow. A scenario level, not a probability.

status.note: Preview only. Project kill tests are not passed: Kill Test 1 met its all-hours bar but reports/sample_model.md finds no usable onset skill, and crossing-level tests T12, T13, E1 failed (docs/claims.md). No forecast skill and no new hydrologic model is claimed. Not validated against Florence closures.

known_gaps: STRESS TEST: every value here is exaggerated on purpose.
No storm surge, tide, or rain/drainage flooding; river flow only.

New Hanover (Wilmington) shows little or no loss of access here. That reflects the crossing inventory and graph, not Florence: Wilmington was documented as cut off, and test E3 failed to reproduce it.
Dialysis and nursing-home entries are placeholder facilities at real Census block centroids; no facility inventory of those types is in the pipeline.
The Florence hindcast saturates: most seed crossings exceed their 10-year flow at the peak.
data_sources: NOAA National Water Model v3.0 retrospective (hourly channel flow)
NCDOT structure locations and NBI 2025 (crossing inventory)
OpenStreetMap Geofabrik NC/SC extract (road graph, default speeds)

isolation_probability.definition: PLACEHOLDER for the ML isolation model (not built yet). Shaped from the real replay state of this block over the next 6 h plus noise, so it agrees with the replay by construction and says nothing about any model's skill.

time_to_isolation.definition: PLACEHOLDER: hours from this hour until isolation_probability first reaches 0.5 (0 = already); null = not within the window + 6 h.

isolation_duration.definition: PLACEHOLDER: hours isolation_probability stays >= 0.5 from that onset (truncated at the window + 6 h).

isolation_tolerance.definition: PLACEHOLDER assumption per facility type (dialysis 48, nursing home 72, residential 72); constant across hours; not a sourced input.

flood_probability.definition: PLACEHOLDER: logistic function of the real flow / q10 ratio plus noise; not a calibrated closure probability.

detour_minutes.definition: Real hindcast replay: added drive time to the nearest ED hospital vs baseline. 0 = changed by 1 min or less (engine stores only affected blocks); null = no route (see scenario_lost_access).

critical_crossing_id.definition: Real hindcast replay: first closed crossing on the block's baseline path to an ED hospital; null = none closed on that path this hour.

route_redundancy.definition: Real hindcast replay: ED hospitals reachable within 30 min under that hour's closures.

scenario_lost_access.definition: Real hindcast replay: true = no route to any ED hospital in that hour's RL10 closure state.

flow_ratio_q10.definition: Real: NWM v3.0 retrospective flow of the crossing's reach / its 10-year recurrence flow (> 1 = above RL10).

level_reached.definition: Real: highest recurrence level strictly exceeded that hour (a scenario level, not a probability).

event_first_above_RL10_utc.definition: Real: first hour of the whole Florence hindcast (from 2018-09-13) with flow above the 10-year flow. breaks_first_rank sorts by this, then by consequence.people_affected.

first_hour_above_RL10.definition: Real: first hour in the window with flow above the 10-year flow; null = not in the window.

consequence.definition: Real structural consequence of closing this crossing alone (data/export/consequence_ranking.csv; no hazard input).
